_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with $34.4B bookings in FY15; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Accenture's own FY2015 10-K names off-shore providers, 'in lower-cost locations, particularly in India, that offer services globally that are similar to the services and solutions we offer', among its competitors and says competitors 'may be willing, at times, to price contracts lower than us' and 'may also offer more aggressive contractual terms', and that its own delivery network 'is increasingly concentrated in India and the Philippines', while its own Global Delivery Network grew to about 257,000 people. The stock trades at 19.2x FY16E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (OFFSHORE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing offshore substitution for ACN specifically.

Live: Accenture's own FY2015 10-K says 'Examples of areas of significant change include digital, analytics, mobility, IoT, cloud-based services, as-a-service solutions, security, cognitive computing and information technology automation. ... These technologies, and others that may emerge, could reduce and, over time, replace some of our current business.' At the same time it reports 'growing demand to assist clients with cloud enablement and operation and maintenance of digital-related services'. The stock trades at 19.2x FY16E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of ACN's outsourcing specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with $34.4B bookings in FY15; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.73x; +47% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.31; conservative 2yr +6%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY05-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +12.4%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.4%/yr (FY05-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +28.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2016-02-05) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.73x (33.3% downside to Bear $66 / +19.2% upside to Bull $118) | Adj composite 2.83 vs market 3.14: gap -0.31 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +47% above the EPP floor $67 (13x FY16E $5.17) | Conservative 2-yr case: +6.4% total (+3.2%/yr) | At 19.2x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $131 sits above the BULL case; consulting +15% LC in Q1, FY16 guided +6-9% LC; offshore competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
